notas.texto: Teacher, explain the verb TO BE BORN in the whiteboard. Use the variables WAS/WERE. Practice with the students. If needed, use the following slide to explain.
to be born = nascer · (to) born = NÃO EXISTE. Example: “I born in 1992.” (wrong) → “I was born in 1992.”
In group. Teacher asks and students answer: When were you born? When was your (mother) born? When was your best friend born? When was your teacher born?

conversation.question: Are you able to take care of babies?
What qualities are necessary for one to take care of a baby?
Do you remember a baby who was a little angel?
What kind of baby does your mom say you were: an angel or a brat?
If somebody asked you to change his baby’s diaper, would you accept or turn down?
Who was the cutest baby in your family?
How many babies are there in your family now?
Do you remember any lullaby songs from your childhood? Which one?

evaluation.question: Did you enjoy talking about babies?
